Rangers 5 Jigawa Golden Stars 0 (2 May) | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2010–11 Nigeria Premier League|2010–11]] | nextseason = [[2013 Nigeria Premier League|2013]] }} The '''2012 Nigeria Premier League''' is the 41st season of the competition since its inception, and the 22nd since the rebranding of the league as the "Professional League". Sixteen teams from the [[2010–11 Nigeria Premier League|previous season]] and four teams promoted from the [[Nigeria National League]] (Akwa United, Rising Stars, Jigawa Golden Stars and Wikki Tourists) are participating in this season. The season was originally due to start November 26, 2011, less than a month after the conclusion of the previous season due to many long delays by the NFF.[http://www.kickoff.com/news/24559/one-month-off-season-for-nigeria-premier-league.php One month offseason for NPL] The date was pushed back to January 2012 to give time to organize and to sort out the league's sponsorship and scheduled to run to July.{{Cite web |url=http://www.mtnfootball.com/africa/nigeria/premier-league/news/2011/nov/14-new-npl-season-begins-january.html |title=New NPL season begins in January |access-date=2011-11-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111117221203/http://www.mtnfootball.com/africa/nigeria/premier-league/news/2011/nov/14-new-npl-season-begins-january.html |archive-date=2011-11-17 |url-status=dead }} ==Clubs== {{location map+ |Nigeria |float=none |width=480 |caption=Locations of the '''Nigeria Premier League 2011–12''' teams |places= {{location map~ |Nigeria |lat=11.99 |long=8.52 |label= [[Kano Pillars F.C.|Kano Pillars]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Nigeria |lat=4.77 |long=7.02 |label= [[Dolphins F.C.
